say:1:1623415001:2.text: The Q&A officially begins. After a few hyped-up opening lines, several guest reporters are invited onstage.
say:1:1623415001:2.source_cn: 问答会正式开始。主持人的几句热情开场后，几位特邀记者被...

say:3:1623415002:3.text: They look a little nervous at first, but the crowd keeps tossing easy, funny questions. The mood heats up. The reporters fire back with jokes, and the audience keeps laughing and clapping.
say:3:1623415002:3.source_cn: 他们起初略显紧张，但随着台下抛出一个个轻松有趣的话题，...

say:4:1623415003:1.text: This isn't a "news seminar". It's a gossip contest. Everyone's trying to top the last person's story.
say:4:1623415003:1.source_cn: 这里不像是所谓的新闻研讨会，反而更像是家长里短的爆料比...

say:5:1623415004:1.text: As one "shocking reveal" after another is thrown into the discussion, the event reaches a fever pitch. Then a cold voice pierces the merriment.
say:5:1623415004:1.source_cn: 在一个又一个“惊天新闻曝光”的讨论中，会议气氛达到高潮...

say:7:1623415005:3.text: If this is what you're calling a "news seminar", that's sad.
say:7:1623415005:3.source_cn: 如果将这些内容称之为“新闻研讨”，那未免太过可悲。

say:8:1623415006:1.text: The whole place goes silent. Everyone turns to look at the skinny student standing in the corner.
say:8:1623415006:1.source_cn: 全场瞬间安静下来，所有目光都诧异地投向角落里的清瘦学生。

say:10:1623415008:3.text: I'm Reeo, an upperclassman at the Lyceum. And if you haven't noticed, a lot of students are still suffering because of the magic contract. Some of them are starting to doubt magic itself.
say:10:1623415008:3.source_cn: 我是雷欧，莱希拉姆的高阶学生。各位，如今还有不少学生因...

say:11:1623415009:1.text: So tell me, have any of you on that stage paid even the slightest attention to the problems that actually affect people's futures?
say:11:1623415009:1.source_cn: 请问台上的各位，对于这些真正影响许多同学未来的困境，你...

say:12:1623415010:1.text: We write what people want to read. What's wrong with that?
say:12:1623415010:1.source_cn: 我们更愿意报道同学们感兴趣的话题，这有什么不对吗？

say:13:1623415011:1.text: When you turn everything into a joke, people stop talking about the stuff that actually matters. At that point it's not news anymore. It's a distraction! And all it does is drown out the students who are struggling to be heard.
say:13:1623415011:1.source_cn: 当轻浮筑起高墙，隔绝了对沉重现实的必要讨论时，你们的“...

say:14:1623415012:1.text: This student doesn't sound like the rest of the crowd at all. Everyone else is here for a laugh, and he's actually talking sense. If anyone can help you figure out what those "freelance reporters" are really doing, it's probably him.
say:14:1623415012:1.source_cn: 这位学生的见解与现场浮躁的气氛格格不入。或许……他可以...
say:14:1623415012:1.male: This student doesn't sound like the rest of the crowd at all. Everyone else is here for a laugh, and he's actually talking sense. If anyone can help you figure out what those "freelance reporters" are really doing, it's probably him.
say:14:1623415012:1.female: This student doesn't sound like the rest of the crowd at all. Everyone else is here for a laugh, and he's actually talking sense. If anyone can help you figure out what those "freelance reporters" are really doing, it's probably him.

say:15:1623415013:1.text: This isn't news. It's just noise. It wastes time and makes people stop thinking—that's all it does.
say:15:1623415013:1.source_cn: 这不是新闻，而是无聊的喧嚣。这些稿件，除了消耗时间、麻...

say:16:1623415014:1.text: It's just junk dressed up as headlines!
say:16:1623415014:1.source_cn: 它们只是披着新闻外衣的废品！

say:17:1623415015:1.text: Host, he's killing the mood. Kick him out!
say:17:1623415015:1.source_cn: 主持人，我认为那些蓄意破坏交流氛围的人，不适合留在这里！

say:18:1623415016:1.text: Really? Someone says one honest thing and your answer is "kick him out"?
say:18:1623415016:1.source_cn: 怎么，虚伪的面具被戳破，剩下的就只有驱逐异己的本能了吗？

say:19:1623415017:1.text: That's when you notice it. One of the reporters on stage shoots a look into the crowd. A second later, a young man dressed like a student rushes out and starts yelling, trying to whip everyone up.
say:19:1623415017:1.source_cn: 正在这时，你敏锐地注意到台上的记者冲着台下某处使了个眼...
say:19:1623415017:1.male: That's when you notice it. One of the reporters on stage shoots a look into the crowd. A second later, a young man dressed like a student rushes out and starts yelling, trying to whip everyone up.
say:19:1623415017:1.female: That's when you notice it. One of the reporters on stage shoots a look into the crowd. A second later, a young man dressed like a student rushes out and starts yelling, trying to whip everyone up.

say:22:1623415018:1.text: Oh, so now you get to decide what we're allowed to enjoy? I get it. You're trying to wreck the newspaper—that's what this is!
say:22:1623415018:1.source_cn: 你凭什么用自己的喜好否定我们喜欢的内容？！你一定是故意...

say:23:1623415019:1.text: Get out of here! Stop trash-talking the newspaper! Ow, hey! He just hit me! Get him! Throw him out!
say:23:1623415019:1.source_cn: 滚开！我们不允许你诋毁秘闻社的新闻！啊——你，你打伤我...

say:26:1623415021:0.text: His exaggerated cry of pain fires up the students. Next thing you know, there's a scuffle and the whole place descends into chaos.
say:26:1623415021:0.source_cn: 随着夸张的呼痛声，现场学生情绪被莫名点燃，冲突突然爆发...

say:27:1623415022:1.text: You frown. This isn't random. Someone wanted things to get loud and messy, so nobody could stop and ask questions.
say:27:1623415022:1.source_cn: 你皱起了眉头，他们故意制造这场混乱，难道就为了不让人质...
